description: Catalogue of built-in configuration profiles (URS-101). Each entry is a starting point a laboratory can load and then adapt in the configuration editor. Profiles marked editorOnly cannot be counted with as-is and are offered only as editor templates. Layouts that differ only in key assignment or M:E composition are not separate profiles: both are fields, editable in the Configuration Editor.

presets.name: Full 14-Part Consensus
presets.summary: Complete 14-category differential for bone marrow and peripheral blood, with M:E ratio. Key layout and M:E composition are editable in the Configuration Editor.

presets.name: Harmonized 10-Part
presets.summary: Ten-category harmonised panel following contemporary reporting practice.

presets.name: Legacy 10-Part
presets.summary: Ten-category panel matching older mechanical counter layouts.

presets.name: Minimal 5-Part
presets.summary: Five-category screening differential for routine peripheral blood.

presets.name: Body Fluid
presets.summary: CSF, pleural, peritoneal and synovial categories per CLSI H56-A (URS-011).

presets.name: Custom (Blank Template)
presets.summary: Empty starting point for building a profile from scratch in the configuration editor.
